name: com.onetext.core
description: Free, open-source text engine for Unity. Every language, shaped correctly — HarfBuzz + FreeType based OpenType shaping (Arabic, Devanagari, Thai, and more), bidirectional text, SDF rendering, and drop-in uGUI integration. MIT licensed, no paid tiers.

samples.description: Full ICU word lists for the scripts that do not write spaces. The package ships a small starter list so Thai wraps sensibly out of the box; import this to wrap all four properly. 4.2 MB of text, so it is an import rather than a dependency — a project that ships none of these languages should not carry it. Unicode license, not LGPL.
